title: Soundscape
description: Atmospheric area sounds for scenes. A scene carries any number of sound sets, each a pool of small audio files with a play style: Interval sets fire a random one-shot, then wait interval ± variation seconds of silence — the crow, the quiet, the distant dog that make an area feel alive. Loop sets play the pool as a continuous bed under equal-power crossfades: a single file loops seamlessly into itself with no loop-point authoring, and several files become a slowly evolving chorus that never repeats exactly and never cuts. Sets can be gated to day or night by scene darkness, quiet down automatically during combat, and play through the Ambient volume channel. Entirely client-side and stateless — per-client randomness is the point — with a live-apply editor window on the scene config and a small API for programmatic authoring.
